name: @promopilot/keyword-density
description: Analyse keyword density from the command line: top words and 2-3 word phrases of a web page, HTML file or plain text with counts and density, stop words for English, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish and German, and a target keyword check (density, title, H1, description, first 100 words). Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, library and GitHub Action. Free online version by PromoPilot.
author: Alexandr Krikun (https://github.com/ksanyok)
